rng: random.Random(20260925), a fresh generator per source; categories visited in sorted order; ids sorted before rng.sample

scriptmem.reason: The public release omits the script conversations. Every data/raw/*.json holds only `conversation.format_example`, a two-utterance synthetic schema example, and the README says 'the released data does not include the original script conversation text'. The questions, options and gold answers are public; the memory to Add is not, so no Add can be formed and no tenant can be measured.

personamem_v2.question_id_rule: 0-based row index in benchmark.csv as 'row<NNNN>' (the CSV has no id)

memlens_32k.allocation: proportional, largest remainder (record: 120 of 789, stratified by type)

mobilemem_omni.allocation: all questions of the drawn users (record)
